carrier.tsv counts a TRANSPORT, not a route group: a transport another group or app also rides counts that traffic here too
latency_ms is the end-of-set legs.json snapshot, not the latency measured on the row
shares and verdicts are computed over the legs of ACTIVE groups only; standby legs are listed with their bytes and a "-" share
